annotations.title: utilpeek: live FX rates from Base stablecoin pools (EUR, GBP, MXN, BRL, CAD, SGD, ZAR, IDR) with ECB deviation, plus exchange bid/ask for the majors

description: utilpeek: Use when an agent needs live on-chain USD rates for 8 currencies or exchange quotes for 4 major pairs, not the ECB fix. For the ECB fix or a past date use get_fx_rates. Returns on-chain FX bid/ask/mid with ECB deviation_pct; indicative quotes from a regulated exchange for EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY, AUDUSD only (`exchange_quotes`). USDCAD has no exchange quote. Matching gap_pct in exchange_gaps. Indicative, not dealable or synchronized arbitrage. Pools cached 15 s; `thin`/`errors` reported. Exchange cache 60 s; stale=true data kept at most 300 s. as_of/age_s: fetch age, not venue age; venue_timestamp null. Exchange-only empty: 503 exchange_unavailable (not charged). Unknown pair: 422 (not charged). Typically 2 to 4 s (two chain reads). Price: USD 0.002. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/live-fx-rates-api.html

amount_usd.description: Reference trade size in USD for the price-impact measurement, 100 to 100000 (default 1000). A pair whose impact at this size is 1% or more is listed under `thin`.
amount_usd.title: Amount Usd

pairs.description: Pairs in market convention, for example EURUSD (USD per EUR) or USDMXN (MXN per USD). Omit for every supported pair; USDJPY and AUDUSD return exchange quotes only. USDCAD is on-chain only, with no exchange quote. An unknown pair is a 422 that lists the supported ones.
pairs.title: Pairs

name: get_live_fx_rates

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.

age_s.description: Seconds since fetch, not venue quote age.

as_of.description: Fetch-window start, not a venue timestamp.

venue_timestamp.description: Null when not supplied by the ticker.
